Emma (sales): Heads-up — Switchbox POC kickoff. They want a drop-in replacement for CompetitorX's text-generation endpoint. Main asks: prompt parity, token billing delta, SSO/KMS requirements. Can we list the minimal acceptance criteria?
Raj (solutions): Quick checklist: 1) API surface compatibility (headers, status codes) 2) sample prompt parity tests 3) deterministic fallback plan (variant models) 4) security questionnaire answers.
Maria (presales): For parity tests I recommend 10 canonical prompts across categories (summarize, rewrite, extraction) + fuzz set. We'll capture outputs and compare BLEU/ROUGE and token counts.
Oliver (ML Eng): Note: CompetitorX uses a different tokenization for some unicode sequences — expect ~3-8% token delta on their dataset. Also their default model applies a mild repetition penalty; we'll need to checkpoint that for parity.
Jenna (Security): @Emma please confirm Switchbox requires customer-managed keys or are they okay with our KMS? Also SSO type (SAML vs OIDC), IP allowlist, and retention window. They'll need SOC2 + GDPR notes in the questionnaire.
Emma (sales): They prefer BYOK for sensitive endpoints, but will accept managed keys for initial POC. SSO = SAML. Retention <= 30 days.
Raj (solutions): On response shape: we should implement a lightweight adapter that maps CompetitorX's envelope -> our response. Minimal shim mapping example: 
```
// competitor-like response
{
  "id": "abc123",
  "text": "...",
  "meta": { "determinism": 0.7 }
}
// map to Redwood format
{
  "request_id": "abc123",
  "choices": [{ "text": "..." }],
  "meta": { "determinism": 0.7 }
}
```
Maria (presales): Acceptance criteria ideas: 1) mean token delta <= 10% across canonical set, 2) semantic score delta (BLEU/ROUGE) within tolerance, 3) latencies <= 1.5x CompetitorX in our staging region, 4) no PII leakage in sample outputs.
Oliver (ML Eng): For cost estimate: if token delta is +8% and they run 50M tokens / month, that's +4M tokens -> cost delta x our per-token rate. We should show both hosted and dedicated pricing options (dedicated reduces unit cost).
Emma (sales): Pricing ask from Switchbox: can we offer a 3-month ramp credit or discounted commit for Dedicated?
Raj (solutions): Yes — we can propose a staged commit: month1 0 commit (trial credits), month2-3 50% commit discount, month4+ full commit. I'll draft numbers.
Jenna (Security): For the questionnaire: we'll provide answers for encryption at rest (AES-256), customer KMS integration steps, audit log format, and incident response SLA. Also need to confirm whether they require an on-prem package for air-gapped evaluation.
Emma (sales): They asked about egress IPs for firewall allowlist. Can eng provision static egress for staging?
deploy-bot: staging cluster created: swbx-poc-staging (egress IPs: 3.12.45.67, 3.12.45.68)
Raj (solutions): Nice. For smoke runs, Maria — can you prepare a Postman collection + a small shell script to run 100 prompts against CompetitorX and Redwood for side-by-side diffs? Example curl to call Redwood shim: 
```
curl -X POST https://api.redwood.ai/v1/swbx-shim/generate \
  -H "Authorization: Bearer $TOKEN" \
  -H "Content-Type: application/json" \
  -d '{"prompt":"Summarize: ...","max_tokens":150}'
```
Maria (presales): On it. I'll include token accounting in output and a TSV with prompt,text_redwood,text_competitor,redwood_tokens,competitor_tokens.
Oliver (ML Eng): Also include model variant toggles in the test matrix: our default quantized, float16, and a 'soft-match' variant where we tweak repetition penalty to better match competitor behavior.
Jenna (Security): One blocker: legal needs a DPA and export control review before we ship sample logs containing customer prompts. @Emma can you loop Legal?
Emma (sales): Looping legal now, scheduling kickoff with Switchbox for Thursday 10am PT. Action items: @Maria prepare test harness, @Raj draft pricing ramp, @Jenna assemble security Q answers, @Oliver prepare model variant config and reproducible seed. :thumbsup:
Oliver (ML Eng): Will add seed and exact config to the repo.
Maria (presales): I'll upload results to the staging workspace and share link before the call.
Emma (sales): Thanks team — keeping this thread for async notes. If anything urgent ping me.
